subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this `question.*` Gateway contract and public `question-gateway-runtime` plugin SDK subpath as the permanent provider-neutral human-input API?
rationale: The remaining code defects are mechanically repairable, but the PR also establishes durable protocol, authorization, native-client, and external plugin contracts that require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt after repairs
options.body: Keep the architecture, require the three blocking fixes plus direct Codex-contract and refreshed-head validation, then land the public API.

options.title: Keep internal first
options.body: Land only internal runtime and channel seams while deferring the public plugin SDK subpath until external consumer requirements are established.

options.title: Defer the runtime
options.body: Continue with provider-specific question bridges and revisit the provider-neutral API in a narrower proposal.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the architecture, require the three blocking fixes plus direct Codex-contract and refreshed-head validation, then land the public API.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Codex question slice and this follow-up place this person closest to the intended product and API split.
